explication: FreeToken is an edge-native MoE inference and serving runtime. Its principal workflow accepts chat or completion requests, tokenizes and schedules them, executes model inference using KV/expert caching and specialized kernels, then streams generated text and tool-call data through compatible APIs. The repository also exposes an offline generation interface, multimodal input processing, cache and memory controls, and a separate daemon for managing serve-process lifecycle. The README documents runtime capabilities not visible in the sampled excerpts; those are represented at subsystem level, with uncertain internal wiring omitted.
